name: Kujou Yuuto
source: A cheeky and twisted truant teenage boy. He’s Shishio’s younger brother but the sight of his brother disgusts him. He can’t control his curse properly so he hides his animal ears with a hairband.
translation: A cheeky and twisted truant teenage boy. He’s Shishio’s younger brother but the sight of his brother disgusts him. He can’t control his curse properly so he hides his animal ears with a hairband.
